title: Momentum-projected hadron entanglement from lattice-QCD replica correlators
summary: We define a finite-volume lattice-QCD observable for the vacuum-subtracted spatial Rényi response of a source--sink-prepared, momentum-projected hadron. At fixed regulator, integer replica index $n>1$, spatial region and gauge-theory cut prescription, double-sided state projection expresses this response as a ratio of replicated and ordinary hadron correlators. The first numerical target is the $n=2$ ratio; its proposed $L^{-3}$ scaling at fixed physical region is to be tested with matched volumes.
